items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Right. I went from him to Bob Chester to Muggsy Spanier.

ctx.x: Right. I went from him to Bob Chester to Muggsy Spanier.

Talk about Bob Chester a minute. He's always intrigued me, perhaps because it's through an awful lot of mist I look back at it, I recall that as a hell of a good band and one of the great themes of all times was his theme, and now that I mentioned that, I'd love to think you wrote it.
